description: Secobarbital, marketed as Seconal, is a short-acting barbiturate sedative-hypnotic. It enhances inhibitory neurotransmission via positive allosteric modulation of GABA-A receptors, leading to CNS depression. It is indicated for short-term management of insomnia and as a preanesthetic sedative. Due to risks of tolerance, dependence, misuse, and respiratory depression, use is limited and closely monitored.

sections.content: Secobarbital, marketed as Seconal, is a short-acting barbiturate sedative-hypnotic. It enhances inhibitory neurotransmission via positive allosteric modulation of GABA-A receptors, leading to CNS depression. It is indicated for short-term management of insomnia and as a preanesthetic sedative. Due to risks of tolerance, dependence, misuse, and respiratory depression, use is limited and closely monitored.
